channelWebsocket.description: Designed WebSocket transport for channels.<name>. The path is derived from the channel key, authentication is a channel-specific bearer token, and exactly one connection per channel is allowed. This route does not exist in the production route table yet; it is design-only.

name.description: Channel key; equals channels.<name> and hello.params.name.

channelWebsocket.title: Channel WebSocket transport (design-only)

session_id.description: Session path parameter; names match the Go target route.

sessionEventsLive.description: Live SSE stream for one session (`GET /api/sessions/{session_id}/events`). Frame names and payloads are frozen in contracts/sse-frames/reference/live.json.

session_id.description: Session path parameter; names match the Go target route.

sessionEventsLive.title: Session live event stream

sessionEventsReplay.description: Reconnect replay on the live endpoint. The client resumes with the last seen sequence id; the replayed frame set is frozen in contracts/sse-frames/reference/replay.json. This is a resume behavior, not a separate HTTP route.

session_id.description: Session path parameter; names match the Go target route.

sessionEventsReplay.title: Session replay after reconnect

sessionEventsStop.description: Shutdown tail of the live stream observed around DELETE /api/sessions/{session_id}; frozen in contracts/sse-frames/reference/stop.json. Not a separate route.

session_id.description: Session path parameter; names match the Go target route.

sessionEventsStop.title: Session shutdown tail
sessionEventsStop.x-note: Captured shutdown tail; not a distinct route.

result.description: 空对象表示已停止；超时后宿主关闭 stdin，等待 2s，再杀死进程。

current_tool_calls.description: No elements observed in the reference snapshot; item shape is not frozen.

info.description: AsyncAPI 3 contract for Hive's realtime surfaces. The SSE channels are backed by frozen frame goldens in contracts/sse-frames. The channel WebSocket transport is design-only and is not a production route; the existing stdio channel transport remains unchanged.

info.x-perspective: Operations are described from the channel plugin's perspective: action send means plugin -> host, action receive means host -> plugin.
